item.description:
A young man in his 20s was moderately to seriously injured in a violent incident in Shibli.
Magen David Adom teams provided him with medical treatment before evacuating him to HaEmek Hospital in Afula.

item.title: Two terrorists eliminated by security forces near Ramallah, IDF investigating
item.description:
Two terrorists were eliminated and another Palestinian Arab was critically wounded by gunfire from Israeli security forces in the village of al-Mughayyir near Ramallah.
The troops opened fire after Palestinian Arabs hurled cinder blocks at them during an operation to locate livestock that had been stolen from Jews.
The IDF Spokesperson's Unit said that the incident and the events that preceded it are under investigation.

item.title: Trump doesn't rule out arming the Iranian people
item.description:
President Donald Trump was asked on Wednesday whether he would send the CIA to arm Iranian citizens after he asked on Truth Social: "When are the Iranian people going to rise up against and fight?"
While the President did not answer directly, he did not rule it out.
"I understand their plight. They are being shot right now... As of three months ago, 52,000 protesters were killed. Now I hear that probably 20-25 thousand more were killed. They have killed close to 65,000 protesters. So when I ask that question, I ask it knowing the answer. The answer is that they are being shot. The regime is getting weaker by the day, and at some point they won't be able to shoot so easily because the people are not going to take it."
Sorry, that tweet doesn't exist!

Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said in an interview with Neve Dromi on i24NEWS that Israel has not yet completed its mission in Iran.
“All of our systems, under my direction, are working to bring down this regime and defeat it," he said.

item.title: Trump to Channel 12: Israel doesn't need to worry about a renewed war with Iran

US President Donald Trump told Channel 12 that Israel need not worry about a renewed war with Iran.
“Israel should not worry. You know why? Because I’m the president, and I will take care of Israel," Trump told Channel 12 in a phone call.
